hotspot_events.title: PCB/CCL price-increase chain escalates: Kingboard 8th price adjustment +15%, Panasonic some CCLs up 3x in 2027
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Kingboard's 8th price adjustment of the year, electronic cloth up over 10% again within the month, and Panasonic's 3x increase in 2027 converge, making the Q4 order window clear
hotspot_events.summary: Kingboard Laminates announced a 15% price increase on new orders for 2116 and thinner glass-fiber cloth CCLs and prepregs starting today, marking the eighth price adjustment this year; Panasonic notified customers that certain general multi-layer board CCLs (R-1705/R-1766/R-1566/R-1755 series) will increase in price by 200% (3 times) starting with shipments on 2027-1-1, covering five major production bases in Koriyama, Guangzhou, Suzhou, Taiwan, and Thailand; electronic cloth prices rose over 10% further in October (7628 +1.5 RMB/meter, G75 electronic yarn +3,000 RMB/ton, thin cloth +2.5 RMB/meter); Citi expects Kingboard to raise prices by another ~10% in November/December, with the average spot price potentially rising to 420 RMB/sheet by year-end.
numbers: Kingboard CCL: new orders +15% effective immediately (8th increase this year)
Panasonic: select CCL +200% (3x) for shipments from Jan 1, 2027
Citi: Kingboard may add ~10% in Nov/Dec; year-end spot average could reach RMB 420/sheet

hotspot_events.title: Copper prices pull back: LME Oct 14 close ~14,436 $/ton, aluminum drops below 3,000 $ to annual low
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Copper prices pull back after BHP strike risk is resolved, ICSG issues 2026 surplus expectation, signaling Q4 price-locking window
hotspot_events.summary: LME 3-month copper closed on Oct 14 at approximately 14,436 $/ton (-0.97%, pulling back after touching a high of 14,700 $ during the session, the highest since Sep 23, following the resolution of strike risks at BHP's Escondida copper mine); ICSG projects a global refined copper supply surplus of about 104,000 tons in 2026; LME 3-month aluminum fell 1.7% to 2,987.5 $/ton, breaking the 3,000 threshold to reach an annual low; Shanghai aluminum AL2611 closed at 23,120 RMB/ton, with Foshan A00 spot at 23,690 RMB/ton.
numbers: ICSG: 2026 refined copper supply surplus ~104 kt
